1: Hor. I, 1 ראוי לה׳ authorized to teach
Hor. I, 1 הוֹרוּ ב"ד וכ׳ if a court has (through error) directed to transgress one of the commands &c
Ib. 2 ה׳ ב"ד וידעו וכ׳ if a court has given a decision and finding out its mistake reversed it
Hor. I, 4 (if a court gave a wrong decision) לא היה מ׳ של ב"ד שם in the absence of the mufla
3: Hor. III, 1 עבר ממְשִׁיחוּתוֹ resigned his office.
Hor. III, 3 אין על גַּבָּיו אלא וכ׳ none over him save the Lord his God
Hor. III, 4 ואיזהו המ׳ המשוח וכ׳ what high priest is called mashiaḥ? He who has been anointed &c
Hor. III, 5 כהן גדול פורם מלמטה וכ׳ the high priest in mourning tears his lower garments
Hor. III, 7 (13^a) בזמן ששניהם עומדים לק׳ (Bab. ed. בק׳) when both (a man and a woman) are exposed to disgrace (prostitution, v. קָלוֹן)
Hor. III, 7 האשה … מבית הש׳ a woman has the precedence of a man with regard to clothes and to relief from prison.
Hor. III, 8 ממזר … קודם לכ"ג ע"ה a bastard who is a scholar has the precedence of an ignorant high priest
Hor. III, 8 כהן קודם לל' ל' וכ' a priest goes before a Levite (in religious privileges), a Levite before an Israelite
